verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk registry extracts, such as business-entity or filing datasets, is a fair axis for a Secretary of State, so the story applies. Nothing in the pack shows any bulk download, dataset, or extract. The cited material covers Gateway portal administration, OHID sign-in, and tax filing tools such as the forms library and rate finder, none of which is a machine-readable public-data extract. The probes recorded HTTP 403 at robots.txt on both ohiosos.gov and the Business Central portal, so no SOS pages were examined.
